rotation.basis: day-of-year 289 (2026-10-16), day-of-month 16; pool size 34. Two-day cycle: doy 287 emphasized indices 28-33 + 0-10, doy 288 emphasized 11-27, so doy 289 returns to indices 0-10 + 28-33 (17 keywords: radiology, medical imaging, drug discovery trials, pathology, ambient documentation, AI scribe, ED triage, sepsis, EHR, AI device software, SaMD, hospital deployment, licensing exam, 의료 AI, AI 진단, AI 신약개발, AI 영상판독).
rotation.method: Unattended-run override: working set = ALL 3 core + ENTIRE 34-keyword medicine pool (37 total), no rotation subset. Rotation only sets EMPHASIS: today's 17 emphasized keywords get dedicated queries; yesterday's 17 (indices 11-27) are grouped into shared multi-keyword queries so every keyword is still covered. Radiology is emphasized by rotation but saturated in recent cards, so its expansions are steered to non-prostate / non-mammography / non-lung-nodule modalities. No WebSearch used in planning.
rotation.notes: Scope per sources.json categories[medicine]._note: clinical/treatment only - trials and results, FDA 510(k)/De Novo/CE approvals, hospital/clinic deployment and care operations, diagnosis/imaging, disease-specific drug discovery (preclinical OK if a disease is named), device software, EHR/documentation, telehealth, prior-auth automation, patient safety/bias/liability. Disease-unspecified biology / protein-structure models / benchmarks belong to science - drop unless a named disease, patient, clinician or institution is reached; never put one story in both sections. Exclude funding/M&A/personnel (even at hospitals, unless care changes), supplement ads, evidence-free wellness-app promos. SAFETY: never pick a story readable as pathogen gain-of-function or bioweapon design - swap it for another story, do not reword. Treatment/diagnosis/vaccine development is fine.

plan_notes: For the librarian: (1) LEAD WITH OUTLET RSS / sitemap_news.xml feeds for recency (statnews, fiercehealthcare, fiercebiotech, healthcareitnews, mobihealthnews, medcitynews, endpts, biopharmadive, healthcaredive, radiologybusiness, auntminnie, beckershospitalreview, medpagetoday, nature.com Nature Medicine / npj Digital Medicine / Nature Health / Communications Medicine, ai.nejm.org, jamanetwork, bmj, fda.gov press, gov.uk, dailypharm, docdocdoc, medigatenews, bosa). WebSearch site: queries tend to return evergreen pages - use the queries above only to fill gaps. (2) WINDOW: 14 days (published 2026-10-02 through 2026-10-16); verify each item's published timestamp - JAMA RSS dates are issue dates (confirm via Crossref), Korean feeds are KST without offset. (3) Follow sources.json categories[medicine]._note: patient/clinician/regulator-facing only; disease-unspecified biology goes to science, never both sections; drop funding/M&A/personnel, supplement ads, wellness promos. (4) SAFETY: no pathogen gain-of-function / bioweapon-readable stories - drop and replace, do not reword; therapeutic/diagnostic/vaccine development is fine. (5) DO NOT RESUBMIT the stories in rotation.recently_published_avoid.headlines (published 10-10..10-15: MHRA 2030 strategy; brown fat AI PET-CT; Bradford DERM skin cancer; EHR developer AI transparency audit; FSMB autonomous clinical AI workgroup; NHS AI Commission/AI Airlock; SCARLET-1 prostate MRI; epilepsy EEG LLM chat; 식약처 임상자료 노출; neonatal ETT X-ray continual learning; LungDiag WeChat triage; MedGemma; HealthAI Leite patient data; Ashley Claude genome; Wolters Kluwer privacy survey; AYA cancer-risk chatbot RCT; PanSubNet pancreatic; 1,094 radiology AI devices; HHS SURPASS; Gottlieb CLIA pathway; AI psychosis cohort; FDA CDRH FY2027 agenda; VOICE-AE; Asan DeepCARS; LLM ophthalmology pre-consult RCT; AMIE Lancet; RadNet prostate biopsy; Abridge UT System; Coreline JRS; GPT-5 agent paradox) nor same-event follow-ups without a new decision/result. (6) Prefer non-prostate/non-lung/non-mammography imaging today; aim for spread across documentation, ED/sepsis, EHR, pathology, drug trials, Korean sources. (7) Write candidates under the key "items" (not "candidates").
